title: Promotion Notice
description: What the director tells the user IMMEDIATELY when promoting a failed task to a Rescue Agent (or granting a mid-task escalation request). Never a silent decision. See RESCUE-PROTOCOL.md. If the promotion needs the user to change model settings, or exceeds a pre-approved model/effort range, or requires extra cost, this notice doubles as an approval request — the director does not start the Rescue Agent until approval is granted.

task.description: The task_id or short description being promoted.

failure_count.description: Number of counted failed loops on this task (per FAILURE-LOOP.md). Rescue Agent promotion requires at least 2.

failed_approaches.description: What each failed attempt actually tried — not a vague 'it didn't work'.

promotion_reason.description: The specific reason promotion is judged necessary — tie this to the RESCUE-PROTOCOL.md Step 1 classification (reasoning_gap / model_capability_gap).

editable_scope.description: What the Rescue Agent is allowed to change.

forbidden_scope.description: What the Rescue Agent may NOT touch.

task_scoped_only.description: Always true: the promotion applies to this failed task only, not to the session's default subagent tier.

within_preapproved_range.description: True if rescue_model/rescue_effort are already within what the user has pre-approved. If false, this notice is also an approval request — see approval_status.

approval_status.description: not_required when within_preapproved_range is true. Otherwise starts at 'pending' and the Rescue Agent does not start until it becomes 'granted'.
